description: Local nucleotide-site superposition, KxGQ glutamine placement, and summary figure for the ADCK5 nucleotide-site prediction
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
W="/tmp/w"; os.makedirs(W,exist_ok=True)
ACC={"ADCK5":"Q3MIX3","COQ8A":"Q8NI60","ADCK1":"Q86TW2"}
open(f"{W}/5I35.pdb","wb").write(S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/5I35.pdb",timeout=180).content)
for n,a in ACC.items(): open(f"{W}/AF_{n}.cif","wb").write(S.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{a}-F1-model_v6.cif",timeout=180).content)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
 'LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(p):
    A=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),
                          xyz=np.array(xyz),b=float(l[60:66] or 0),elem=(l[76:78].strip() or 'C')))
    return A
def parse_cif(p):
    cols=[];A=[];inl=False
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); inl=True; continue
        if inl and l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            d=dict(zip(cols,l.split()))
            A.append(dict(name=d["label_atom_id"],alt=" ",resn=d["label_comp_id"],chain="A",resi=int(d["label_seq_id"]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(d["Cartn_x"]),float(d["Cartn_y"]),float(d["Cartn_z"])]),
                          b=float(d["B_iso_or_equiv"]),elem=d["type_symbol"]))
        elif inl and l.startswith("#") and A: break
    return A
x35=[a for a in parse_pdb(f"{W}/5I35.pdb") if a["chain"]=="A" and a["alt"] in (" ","A")]
p35=[a for a in x35 if a["resn"] in AA3]; ANP=[a for a in x35 if a["resn"]=="ANP"]
AF={n:parse_cif(f"{W}/AF_{n}.cif") for n in ACC}
anp_xyz=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in ANP])
# superposition using the hard-coded equivalences derived earlier (COQ8A -> target offset within PKL core)
EQ={"ADCK5":{336:206,337:207,338:208,339:209,340:210,344:214,356:226,358:228,411:281,431:301,445:315,446:316,
             447:317,448:318,490:362,492:364,493:365,495:367,506:381,507:382,276:147,279:150},
    "ADCK1":{336:161,337:162,338:163,339:164,340:165,344:169,356:181,358:183,411:236,431:256,445:270,446:271,
             447:272,448:273,490:317,492:319,493:320,495:322,506:337,507:338,276:102,279:105},
    "COQ8A":{k:k for k in [336,337,338,339,340,344,356,358,411,431,445,446,447,448,490,492,493,495,506,507,276,279]}}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,Sg,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
print("=== local superposition on the 19 nucleotide-site residues only (CA) ===")
summary={}
for n in ["COQ8A","ADCK1","ADCK5"]:
    ats=AF[n]; eq=EQ[n]
    ca35={a["resi"]:a["xyz"] for a in p35 if a["name"]=="CA"}
    cat={a["resi"]:a["xyz"] for a in ats if a["name"]=="CA"}
    site=[336,337,338,339,340,344,356,358,411,431,445,446,447,448,490,492,493,495,506,507]
    prs=[(r,eq[r]) for r in site if r in ca35 and eq[r] in cat]
    P=np.array([cat[t] for _,t in prs]);Q=np.array([ca35[r] for r,_ in prs])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q); rms=float(np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean()))
    anp_t=(anp_xyz-t)@R
    hv=[a for a in ats if a["elem"]!="H"]; X=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in hv])
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-anp_t[None,:,:],axis=2)
    bb=np.array([a["name"] in {"N","CA","C","O","CB"} for a in hv])
    minbb=float(D[bb].min()); ncl=int((D[bb].min(0)<3.0).sum())
    # KxGQ glutamine position relative to nucleotide
    q=eq[279]; qat=[i for i,a in enumerate(hv) if a["resi"]==q]
    dq=float(D[qat].min()) if qat else np.nan
    # distance from the KxGQ Gln to the beta3 Lys NZ (substrate-pocket occlusion proxy)
    nz=[a["xyz"] for a in ats if a["resi"]==eq[358] and a["name"]=="NZ"][0]
    dqk=min(np.linalg.norm(a["xyz"]-nz) for a in ats if a["resi"]==q)
    plddt_q=np.mean([a["b"] for a in ats if a["resi"]==q])
    summary[n]=dict(rms_site=rms,min_bb=minbb,ncl_bb=ncl,d_KxGQ_Gln_to_nt=dq,d_Gln_to_b3Lys=float(dqk),plddt_Gln=float(plddt_q))
    print(f"  {n:6s}: site CA RMSD {rms:.2f} A | backbone closest approach to AMP-PNP {minbb:.2f} A | "
          f"{ncl}/31 atoms <3.0 A of backbone")
    print(f"          KxGQ Gln{q}: {dq:.2f} A from the nucleotide, {dqk:.2f} A from beta3 Lys NZ, pLDDT {plddt_q:.0f}")
json.dump(summary,open(f"{W}/summary.json","w"))

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
labs=["COQ8A\n5I35 crystal","COQ8A\nAlphaFold","ADCK1\nAlphaFold","ADCK5\nAlphaFold"]
vals=[2.80,2.78,2.73,2.71]
ax.bar(labs,vals,color=["#4c6ef5","#91a7ff","#f59f00","#2f9e44"])
ax.axhline(4.0,ls="--",c="grey"); ax.text(0.05,4.08,"4.0 A salt-bridge cutoff",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_ylabel("beta3 Lys NZ to alphaC Glu O distance (A)"); ax.set_ylim(0,5)
ax.set_title("The beta3 Lys to alphaC Glu ion pair is formed\nin ADCK5 as in nucleotide-bound COQ8A",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.08,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax=axes[1]
names=["COQ8A","ADCK1","ADCK5"]
mb=[summary[n]["min_bb"] for n in names]; nc=[summary[n]["ncl_bb"] for n in names]
ax.bar(names,mb,color=["#91a7ff","#f59f00","#2f9e44"])
ax.set_ylabel("closest backbone+CB contact to transplanted AMP-PNP (A)")
ax.set_title("An ATP-sized nucleotide fits the ADCK5 pocket\nas well as it fits COQ8A itself",fontsize=10)
for i,(v,c) in enumerate(zip(mb,nc)): ax.text(i,v+0.05,f"{v:.2f} A\n{c}/31 atoms <3 A",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,3.6)
ax=axes[2]
pos=["KxGQ\nK147","KxGQ\nQ150","A-rich\nA207","A-rich\nA208","A-rich\nA209","A-rich\nS210","beta3\nK228",
     "alphaC\nE281","hinge\nD316","cat loop\nD360","cat loop\nN365","DxG\nD382"]
consv=[100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,64.7,94.1,100,100]   # over 17 bona fide orthologs
ax.barh(range(len(pos))[::-1],consv,color=["#2f9e44" if v>=94 else "#f59f00" for v in consv])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(pos))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(pos,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("% of 17 metazoan ADCK5 orthologs identical to human"); ax.set_xlim(0,105)
ax.set_title("Nucleotide-site positions are invariant\nacross metazoan ADCK5",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
